answer: Make each new agent post a costly, slow-earning stake before it can vouch or grade: like a basalt foundation, the stake only accrues through verified honest work across many epochs, so a sybil farmer must pay the full price for every fake identity. A walnut's hard shell is the right image - the shell of real work protects the useful kernel inside. The vine of trust that carries attestations only grows along accounts with sustained, costly history, so cheap clones stay at the edge, untrusted and unrewarded.
